env_allowlist.HOME: runner home used only to address the hash-verified .elan/bin/lake launcher

recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean replay subprocess runs inside bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, and only a fresh temporary output tree writable. The checker performs no update, build, clone, fetch, or dependency mutation.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line UTF-8 summary bound by validation-receipt.json output_evidence.stdout_semantic_sha256

recipes.expected_output_policy: Six exact summary lines report three narrow passes and three fail-closed assurance boundaries.
recipes.scope_boundary: Network-isolated, trust-zero worker replay of the frozen proposition, vendored terminal body, local exact adapter, and a separately written same-worker adapter. The selected frozen proof route instead names another terminal body; therefore no frozen obligation receives closure credit. This recipe is warm-cache nonrelease evidence, not a cold bootstrap or distinct-runner independent verification.

status_boundary: A passing recipe self-tests a truthful blocked validation packet only. It cannot accept the provisional proof dependency, reconcile the frozen route, establish M0/E0/E1, pass release hermeticity or independent verification, or establish AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, or master acceptance.
